works.body:
Hello painter I like your painting and I would like to trouble you I would like to paint on my oc. My oc is a girl with white hair and rabbit ears, the clothes can refer to my url and the scene is in the bathroom. My oc had filled the tub with water and was ready to enjoy a bubble bath, but the water in the tub was enchanted and she was completely surrounded by a giant soap bubble that came out of the tub before she had even taken off her clothes. The soap bubbles were soft and resilient, they did not shake off, they floated in the bathtub, and the person's expression was one of amazement as the bathtub was still constantly producing smaller soap bubbles. The others could be properly exerted at will, and if you could satisfy my demand, I would be grateful!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15svKDsl8NJcw0pfCk26kxNUcsK6oQZ4S?usp=sharing

Nice to meet you and thank you for your appeal!
I would like to ask you to illustrate Graf Zeppelin (ship).
I think it's a little bit loose around the bosom, and she is aware that the other person is watching her, but she doesn't dare to hide it. A little loose around the bosom.
We will leave the clothes, etc. up to you. You can wear as shown in the official illustration or just a normal shirt, etc.
If you have an opinion about me, why don't you look at me and talk to me? or something like that, something provocative, something that makes the person proud to be seen.

Good evening from the Appeal.
I'm not sure what you mean by "Shioribe" (or "Shiori-mi"), but here is the image I generated for it

Shiori-ba.

Hair and Eyes: Yutani Reika's hair is burgundy, long and beautiful, a vibrant color that evokes the power of magic. Her eyes are a deep green, hiding secrets of knowledge and magic.

Clothing: Yutani Linghua wears a magical costume that symbolizes her role as a Potions Master. Her costume is in shades of crimson and emerald green, embroidered with ghost motifs and alchemical symbols. Around her waist is a belt that holds bottles of magic potions and materials.

Accessories: Yugoku Reika wears a magical pendant around her neck, which is also the source of her magical powers. Also, a ring with a ghost motif shines on her finger. These accessories amplify and protect her magical powers.

Magical Apothecary Tools: As a magical apothecary, Yugoku Reika has a book and a huge magic bottle. The table is lined with test tubes and herbs, and her magic potion concoctions are in progress.

Pose: Reika Yutani is concentrating on her magical concoction, her hands certainly operating as she pours the liquid from the test tubes. Her face is filled with knowledge and joy for the power of magic.

BACKGROUND: Behind her, a magical library and shelves stacked with books of magic, an ocean of knowledge and a world of magic.



Best regards.
